rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An SSH server that enables secure remote command execution through three core tools: ssh_connect for establishing authenticated connections to remote servers, ssh_exec for running commands with real-time output streaming and progress notifications, and ssh_disconnect for clean connection termination. Built using the ssh2 library and MCP SDK, it maintains persistent SSH sessions and handles both stdout and stderr streams, making it useful for remote server administration, automated deployment scripts, system monitoring, and any workflow requiring SSH access.
